name: ZX_SUBSCRIPTION_OPTIONS
description: This table stores the list of date effective content subscription options for each regime of a first party organization defined in ZX_REGIMES_USAGES table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for content subscription option

columns.name: PARENT_FIRST_PTY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for parent first party organization

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the subscription option is enabled

columns.name: ALLOW_SUBSCRIPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether any other first party organization can subscribe to the regime of this subscription option for the time period of this subscription option.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for exceptions content subscription option
